participation.context: Looked at the ruled line and left it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Stayed on the shut Holinshed. He has no lines.
participation.name: Gib

story.body: You looked, and you did not begin a second book, and you did not open the coffer.

title: Looked at the forty leaves under the cat

participation.context: Said the two sentences and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said he has not been told, and you did not send for him.
